title: OpenThrone
metaDescription: Choose a race, forge your class, and command a rising empire in a persistent strategy world. Free to play with no paywalls.

strategicCombat.title: Strategic Combat
strategicCombat.description: Build and train specialized units, then plunder rivals to climb rankings.

espionageOperations.title: Espionage Operations
espionageOperations.description: Deploy spies, sabotage defenses, and strike before your enemies can react.

empireBuilding.title: Empire Building
empireBuilding.description: Construct fortifications, armories, and mines to strengthen your kingdom.

hero.tagline: Choose a race, forge your class, and command a rising empire in a persistent strategy world.

features.chooseRace: Choose between four unique races: Undead, Humans, Goblins, Elves.
features.trainCitizens: Train citizens as workers, offensive or defensive soldiers, and spies.
features.equipArmy: Equip your army with weapons and armor.
features.playWithFriends: Play with friends, create your own alliance, and dominate realm.
features.createProfile: Create a character profile with a custom avatar.
features.stayInTouch: Stay in contact with the team via Discord.

warCouncilBriefing.title: War Council Briefing
warCouncilBriefing.description: Stay current on realm updates, balance patches, and seasonal campaigns. The war room never sleeps.

newcomerProtocol.title: Newcomer Protocol
newcomerProtocol.description: Start with protected turns, earn daily rewards, and learn meta at your pace. We built this realm for long-term rulers.
